mapper.select: SELECT id, name, category, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM ability_tag WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ability_tag (id, name, category, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{category}, #{status})
mapper.update:
UPDATE ability_tag
name = #{name},
category = #{category},
status = #{status},
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id}
